{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p5","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Colonial stone and gold leaf, with a choir worth a quiet pause."},{"poi_id":"p7","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Cacao from bean to bar, and a sweet farewell for the crew."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p2","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m2","note":"Inca stonework so precise even Inti (the sun) seems to pause and admire it."},{"poi_id":"p1","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The old square hums with colonial balconies and quiet photo corners."},{"poi_id":"p6","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Wander the cobbled lanes where artisans keep their doors half open."},{"poi_id":"p14","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"A warm, wood-panelled room with thoughtful vegetarian plates for the whole crew."}]}

{"stops":[{"poi_id":"p3","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m1","note":"Giant Inca stones with a view over the red-tiled roofs, and Inti (the sun) warming the old walls."},{"poi_id":"p4","kind":"activity","must_do_id":"m4","note":"A riot of fruit, flowers, hats and chatter; the juice ladies will sort you out."},{"poi_id":"p16","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Refined Andean plates where the vegetarian set is treated like royalty."},{"poi_id":"p8","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"Gold, textiles and mummies that whisper the Inca story better than I can."},{"poi_id":"p12","kind":"activity","must_do_id":null,"note":"The white Christ looking over the city, best when the light turns honey."},{"poi_id":"p18","kind":"meal","must_do_id":null,"note":"Cosy, honest cooking with proper vegetarian comfort on the menu."}]}
